# Knowledge Work Plugins

> バイオ研究（single-cell RNA-seq・scvi-tools・Nextflow・Allotrope 変換）とデータ抽出を対象とした 5 Skill を含む Claude Code 拡張セット。

---

## Source Modules

### bio-research.skills.instrument-data-to-allotrope.scripts.convert_to_asm

*Source: bio-research/skills/instrument-data-to-allotrope/scripts/convert_to_asm.py | URL: https://github.com/anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins/blob/main/bio-research/skills/instrument-data-to-allotrope/scripts/convert_to_asm.py*

- `get_allotropy`
- `get_pandas`
- `detect_instrument_type`: Auto-detect instrument type from file contents.
- `convert_with_allotropy`: Convert file using allotropy library.
- `get_deterministic_timestamp`: Get deterministic timestamp for file.
- `calculate_file_hash`: Calculate SHA256 hash of file for provenance tracking.
- `get_library_version`: Get version of installed library.
- `add_provenance_metadata`: Add provenance metadata to ASM for reproducibility and audit trail.
- `flexible_parse`: Flexible fallback parser when allotropy fails.
- `build_flexible_asm`: Build ASM-like JSON structure from parsed DataFrame.
- `main`: Main entry point.

### bio-research.skills.instrument-data-to-allotrope.scripts.export_parser

*Source: bio-research/skills/instrument-data-to-allotrope/scripts/export_parser.py | URL: https://github.com/anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins/blob/main/bio-research/skills/instrument-data-to-allotrope/scripts/export_parser.py*

- `generate_script`: Generate standalone Python script for given vendor.
- `generate_notebook`: Generate Jupyter notebook for given vendor.
- `main`

### bio-research.skills.instrument-data-to-allotrope.scripts.flatten_asm

*Source: bio-research/skills/instrument-data-to-allotrope/scripts/flatten_asm.py | URL: https://github.com/anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins/blob/main/bio-research/skills/instrument-data-to-allotrope/scripts/flatten_asm.py*

- `detect_technique`: Detect the ASM technique type from document structure.
- `flatten_value`: Flatten a single ASM value, handling value datum patterns.
- `extract_device_info`: Extract device/instrument information from ASM.
- `flatten_asm`: Flatten ASM JSON to list of row dictionaries.
- `flatten_asm_to_csv`: Flatten ASM and write to CSV file.
- `flatten_asm_to_dict`: Flatten ASM and return as dictionary with rows and columns.
- `main`: Main entry point.

### bio-research.skills.nextflow-development.scripts.utils.file_discovery

*Source: bio-research/skills/nextflow-development/scripts/utils/file_discovery.py | URL: https://github.com/anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins/blob/main/bio-research/skills/nextflow-development/scripts/utils/file_discovery.py*

- `FileInfo`: Information about a discovered file.
- `discover_files`: Recursively discover files of specified type.
- `count_files_by_type`: Count files by type in directory.
- `find_index_file`: Find index file for a BAM or CRAM file.
- `detect_input_type`: Auto-detect predominant input file type in directory.

### bio-research.skills.nextflow-development.scripts.utils.sample_inference

*Source: bio-research/skills/nextflow-development/scripts/utils/sample_inference.py | URL: https://github.com/anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins/blob/main/bio-research/skills/nextflow-development/scripts/utils/sample_inference.py*

- `extract_sample_info`: Extract sample metadata from filepath.
- `infer_tumor_normal_status`: Infer tumor (1) or normal (0) status from sample name.
- `extract_replicate_number`: Extract replicate number from sample name.
- `match_read_pairs`: Match R1/R2 read pairs using scored pattern matching.
- `infer_patient_groupings`: Infer patient groupings from sample names.

### bio-research.skills.nextflow-development.scripts.utils.validators

*Source: bio-research/skills/nextflow-development/scripts/utils/validators.py | URL: https://github.com/anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins/blob/main/bio-research/skills/nextflow-development/scripts/utils/validators.py*

- `ValidationResult`: Result of samplesheet validation.
- `summary`: Generate human-readable summary.
- `load_pipeline_config`: Load pipeline configuration from YAML file.
- `validate_samplesheet`: Validate samplesheet rows against pipeline requirements.
- `validate_file_exists`: Check if file exists and is accessible.
- `validate_absolute_path`: Check if path is absolute.

### bio-research.skills.scvi-tools.scripts.cluster_embed

*Source: bio-research/skills/scvi-tools/scripts/cluster_embed.py | URL: https://github.com/anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins/blob/main/bio-research/skills/scvi-tools/scripts/cluster_embed.py*

- `cluster_and_embed`: Cluster and compute UMAP embedding.
- `plot_results`: Generate and save visualization plots.
- `main`

### bio-research.skills.scvi-tools.scripts.differential_expression

*Source: bio-research/skills/scvi-tools/scripts/differential_expression.py | URL: https://github.com/anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins/blob/main/bio-research/skills/scvi-tools/scripts/differential_expression.py*

- `run_de_analysis`: Run differential expression analysis.
- `plot_volcano`: Create volcano plot of DE results.
- `main`

### bio-research.skills.scvi-tools.scripts.integrate_datasets

*Source: bio-research/skills/scvi-tools/scripts/integrate_datasets.py | URL: https://github.com/anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins/blob/main/bio-research/skills/scvi-tools/scripts/integrate_datasets.py*

- `integrate_datasets`: Integrate multiple datasets.
- `plot_integration`: Plot integration results.
- `main`

### bio-research.skills.scvi-tools.scripts.model_utils

*Source: bio-research/skills/scvi-tools/scripts/model_utils.py | URL: https://github.com/anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins/blob/main/bio-research/skills/scvi-tools/scripts/model_utils.py*

- `get_mito_genes`: Identify mitochondrial genes for both human and mouse data.
- `prepare_adata`: Prepare AnnData for scvi-tools models.
- `train_scvi`: Train scVI or scANVI model.
- `evaluate_integration`: Evaluate integration quality using basic metrics.
- `get_marker_genes`: Get marker genes using scVI differential expression.
- `plot_training_history`: Plot model training history.
- `save_results`: Save model, processed data, and visualization.
- `auto_select_model`: Suggest the best scvi-tools model based on available data.
- `compare_integrations`: Compare multiple integration methods using standard metrics.
- `quick_clustering`: Quick clustering pipeline on latent representation.

### bio-research.skills.scvi-tools.scripts.train_model

*Source: bio-research/skills/scvi-tools/scripts/train_model.py | URL: https://github.com/anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins/blob/main/bio-research/skills/scvi-tools/scripts/train_model.py*

- `train_scvi`: Train scVI model.
- `train_scanvi`: Train scANVI model (scVI + labels).
- `train_totalvi`: Train totalVI model for CITE-seq.
- `train_peakvi`: Train PeakVI model for scATAC-seq.
- `train_velovi`: Train veloVI model for RNA velocity.
- `train_multivi`: Train MultiVI model for multiome (RNA + ATAC).
- `main`

### bio-research.skills.scvi-tools.scripts.transfer_labels

*Source: bio-research/skills/scvi-tools/scripts/transfer_labels.py | URL: https://github.com/anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins/blob/main/bio-research/skills/scvi-tools/scripts/transfer_labels.py*

- `transfer_labels`: Transfer labels from reference to query.
- `plot_predictions`: Plot prediction results.
- `main`

### bio-research.skills.scvi-tools.scripts.validate_adata

*Source: bio-research/skills/scvi-tools/scripts/validate_adata.py | URL: https://github.com/anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins/blob/main/bio-research/skills/scvi-tools/scripts/validate_adata.py*

- `ValidationResult`: Results from AnnData validation.
- `add_error`: Add an error (makes validation fail).
- `add_warning`: Add a warning (doesn't fail validation).
- `add_recommendation`: Add a recommendation for improvement.
- `summary`: Generate summary report.
- `validate_for_scvi`: Validate AnnData for scvi-tools compatibility.
- `suggest_model`: Suggest appropriate scvi-tools model based on data.
- `main`: Command-line interface.

### bio-research.skills.single-cell-rna-qc.scripts.qc_core

*Source: bio-research/skills/single-cell-rna-qc/scripts/qc_core.py | URL: https://github.com/anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins/blob/main/bio-research/skills/single-cell-rna-qc/scripts/qc_core.py*

- `calculate_qc_metrics`: Calculate QC metrics for single-cell RNA-seq data.
- `detect_outliers_mad`: Detect outliers using Median Absolute Deviation (MAD).
- `apply_hard_threshold`: Apply a hard threshold filter.
- `filter_cells`: Filter cells based on a boolean mask.
- `filter_genes`: Filter genes based on detection thresholds.
- `print_qc_summary`: Print summary statistics for QC metrics.

### bio-research.skills.single-cell-rna-qc.scripts.qc_plotting

*Source: bio-research/skills/single-cell-rna-qc/scripts/qc_plotting.py | URL: https://github.com/anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins/blob/main/bio-research/skills/single-cell-rna-qc/scripts/qc_plotting.py*

- `plot_qc_distributions`: Create comprehensive QC distribution plots.
- `plot_filtering_thresholds`: Visualize filtering thresholds overlaid on distributions.
- `plot_with_threshold`
- `plot_qc_after_filtering`: Create QC plots for filtered data (simplified version without outlier overlay).

### data.skills.data-context-extractor.scripts.package_data_skill

*Source: data/skills/data-context-extractor/scripts/package_data_skill.py | URL: https://github.com/anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins/blob/main/data/skills/data-context-extractor/scripts/package_data_skill.py*

- `validate_skill`: Basic validation of skill structure.
- `package_skill`: Package a skill folder into a .skill file.
- `main`
